fact: RISA's CTO told The New Times that Rwanda is establishing a national data sharing platform, to be built in phases from requirements and design through core platform development integrated with pilot systems, with launch of a fully operational portal planned for 2026 and a firm still to be onboarded.
The New Times reports that, according to RISA, the existing Data Sharing Platform serves as an interim system for data governance, data discovery and access.
The New Times reports that, according to RISA, the Shared Government Data Hub and a Data Interoperability Platform are being worked on, with the Data Hub moving into implementation.

RISA held an early market engagement session on its draft RFP for the Shared Government Data Hub and Data Interoperability Platform, stating a 9-month implementation period, 12 months of post-deployment support, and a final RFP to be published before the end of 2025.
